title: Set Predictors to Zero
text: The intercept is the prediction when every feature in the model is set to $$0$$.

title: Evaluate the Feature Values
text: When $$hours_{sleep}$$ $$=$$ $$0$$ and $$is_{cdss}$$ $$=$$ $$0$$, what does the model predict?

title: Interpret $$is_{cdss}$$ $$=$$ $$0$$
text: Since $$is_{cdss}$$ $$=$$ $$0$$ means the student does not have a CDSS-affiliated major, $$\theta_0$$ is the predicted GPA for that baseline student.
